messages:
kevin_csm: quick heads-up — Sierra Pharma submitted an onboarding request. They want to serve a custom embeddings model that will index clinical notes (PHI). Asking for Private deployment + HSM for keying, strict audit logs, and a short eval run to validate retrieval quality.

sam_se: thanks @kevin_csm. can you paste the intake form here or tl;dr the constraints? i need dataset size, expected qps, and whether they can use a hashed identifier scheme. :point_down:

kevin_csm: pasted their summary below. short: ~200k docs (avg 250 tokens), expect 50 qps peak, spike to 150 qps during batch reindex windows. absolutely no raw PHI to leave customer VPC. they asked for KMS with HSM-backed keys + 7 year audit retention. timeline: pilot in 3 weeks, prod in 8 weeks.

ajay_research: quick model/format questions — what embedding dim and framework? are they submitting a PyTorch .pt or ONNX? do they want quantized vectors (int8) on retrieval side?

kevin_csm: they provided a 768-d float32 model (PyTorch) and said they'd accept quantized storage for vectors but need test showing no quality regression > 1.5% on recall@10.

sam_se: perfect. next steps from infra/eng side: 1) confirm Private deployment slot + HSM availability 2) create a scoped eval harness using their test prompts (2k withheld notes) 3) run quantization ablation (fp32 vs int8) on recall@k and MRR 4) define routing policy for pilot (dedicated pool vs shared)

maria_csm: i'll own customer comms and timeline. i'll ask them for consent to run evals on sample in our secure staging and request the legal DPA addendum for PHI handling. can someone add me to the ticket once infra is confirmed?

olivia_pm: product question — do we have a ready-built embedding-serving path with prefix caching + vector-store TTL that meets 7yr audit? if not, we should scope retention work.

hana_security: security note: we'll require a complete data flow diagram and confirmation of in-flight encryption. for HSM we need key rotation policy and proof that keys are customer-owned (bring-your-own-key). also want to run a short threat model for the pilot.

deploybot: infra check: private-region-us-east-2 has one available dedicated pool slot for 8 GPUs w/ HSM attachment (ETA provisioning 4 business days). create request: RDW-11388.

ajay_research: for eval harness we should measure both semantic retrieval and downstream NER leakage. propose the following metrics: recall@10, mrr, mean cosine drop after int8 quant, phi-leakage score (simple regex + fuzzy match). i can spin up the eval notebooks if legal ok's the sample.

sam_se: action items: (1) @maria_csm ask customer for eval sample + signed DPA addendum, (2) @hana_security schedule a 30m threat-model sync, (3) @deploybot / infra to provision RDW-11388, (4) @ajay_research run quant ablation and report delta vs threshold. i'll own the tech checklist and post results here.

maria_csm: noted — i'll ping Sierra now, ask for sample ingest instructions and a redacted sample if feasible. target: get signed DPA within 72h.

kevin_csm: thanks everyone. customer is sensitive about renewal risk — if pilot stalls >8w they may look at alternate vector providers. let's prioritize HSM + legal to avoid blockers.

olivia_pm: i'll reserve a small product spike to handle audit retention hooks if legal flags gaps.

hana_security: scheduling link: https://cal.link/hana/30m — put "Sierra PHI onboarding" in subject.

sam_se: i added a minimal config snippet for the embedding route we'll use:

```
route: /sierra-embeddings
model: custom/sierra-embed-768
private: true
vector_storage: encrypted_s3 (server-side + customer-kms)
hsm_key: customer://projects/sierra/key1
batching: auto (target_latency_ms=120)
quantization: evaluate=int8
```

sam_se: i'll post updates here as tests complete. :thumbsup:
